faqs.a: Your first appointment is the assessment. The clinical team builds a complete picture - your baseline, your biology, your realistic trajectory - before recommending anything. Nothing is prescribed until we understand your skin, and there is no upsell and no commitment.
faqs.q: What happens at my first appointment?

faqs.a: Yes - injectables include Botox, dermal fillers, and Sculptra. Deluxe Med Spa is a top 1% Sculptra provider in California and ranks in the top 10% nationally for Allergan, Galderma, and Merz.
faqs.q: Do you offer Botox and fillers?

faqs.a: Yes - clarity is a core focus. Treatments like IPL Photofacial, PicoSure, and Clear + Brilliant target pigmentation, sun damage, redness, and acne-prone skin. Your clinician will assess your skin first and build the plan around what it actually needs.
faqs.q: Can you help with acne or pigmentation?

faqs.a: We have five Southern California clinics: Los Angeles (2630 West Olympic Blvd, (213) 900-9777), Irvine (2646 Dupont Dr, Suite 250, (949) 350-8889), Hacienda Heights (17188 Colima Rd #B, (626) 686-8666), Diamond Bar (1241 Grand Ave, (909) 686-8888), and Brea (2415 E Imperial Hwy, Suite A, (714) 660-5888).
Deluxe Med Spa was built by Cheryl Chen in 2018, and today 100+ clinical professionals across five locations work the same way: assessment first, plan second.

Many Deluxe treatments are non-invasive - Venus Legacy, for example, firms skin and smooths the look of cellulite without surgery or downtime. Your clinician will walk you through exactly what to expect for your plan at the assessment.
